_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

lineName.description: Display value of lineId, copied from u_mes_mast_line.name

workCenterName.description: Display value of workCenterId, copied from u_mes_mast_workCenter.name

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

fromProductionOrderId.description: Reference to u_mes_plan_productionOrder._id: from production order

fromProductionOrderName.description: Display value of fromProductionOrderId, copied from u_mes_plan_productionOrder.recordNo

toProductionOrderId.description: Reference to u_mes_plan_productionOrder._id: to production order

toProductionOrderName.description: Display value of toProductionOrderId, copied from u_mes_plan_productionOrder.recordNo

fromItemName.description: Display value of fromItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

toItemName.description: Display value of toItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

startedAt.description: Date and time when the record was started

completedAt.description: Date and time when the record was completed

recipeName.description: Display value of recipeId, copied from u_mes_prod_recipe.name

firstOffCheckSheetResultId.description: Reference to u_mes_qual_checkSheetResult._id: first off check sheet result

firstOffCheckSheetResultName.description: Display value of firstOffCheckSheetResultId, copied from u_mes_qual_checkSheetResult.recordNo

firstOffApprovedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'first off approved'

firstOffApprovedBy.description: Display name of the user in firstOffApprovedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

firstOffApprovedAt.description: First off approved date and time

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
